facts.text: The Quarren took the opportunity to rebel against the Mon Calamari with aid from the Confederacy of Independent Systems while the Galactic Republic backed the Mon Calamari.

evidence.section: Lead
evidence.quote: The Quarren took the opportunity to rebel against the Mon Calamari with aid from the Confederacy of Independent Systems while the Galactic Republic backed the Mon Calamari.

facts.text: After defeat to the Confederacy, the Gungan Grand Army came to the help of the Republic.

evidence.section: Lead
evidence.quote: After defeat to the Confederacy, the Gungan Grand Army came to the help of the Republic.

facts.text: During the end of the battle, Quarren and Mon Calamari joined forces to push the Confederacy from Mon Cala.

evidence.section: Lead
evidence.quote: During the end of the battle, Quarren and Mon Calamari joined forces to push the Confederacy from Mon Cala.

facts.text: Mon Cala would play a vital role in shaping galactic history by its involvement in the Galactic Civil War between the tyrannical Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, pledging the ships of its mercantile and exodus fleets to the cause of the latter.

evidence.section: Lead
evidence.quote: Mon Cala would play a vital role in shaping galactic history by its involvement in the Galactic Civil War between the tyrannical Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, pledging the ships of its mercantile and exodus fleets to the cause of the latter.

facts.text: Mon Calamari vessels would play a key role in many battles and allow the Alliance fleet to meet the Imperial warships on a more even footing.

evidence.section: Lead
evidence.quote: Mon Calamari vessels would play a key role in many battles and allow the Alliance fleet to meet the Imperial warships on a more even footing.

facts.text: Mon Cala regrettably paid a steep price for its assistance to the rebellion, however; prompting the remaining population to adopt a policy of isolationism for fear of provoking another atrocity against the planet.

evidence.section: Lead
evidence.quote: Mon Cala regrettably paid a steep price for its assistance to the rebellion, however; prompting the remaining population to adopt a policy of isolationism for fear of provoking another atrocity against the planet.

facts.text: A moon orbited the planet with no atmosphere and a barren terrain.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: A moon orbited the planet with no atmosphere and a barren terrain.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: Both species preferred to build their cities underwater, but there also existed some cities built on the surface of the water.

facts.text: The planet was ruled by a single monarch.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: The planet was ruled by a single monarch.

facts.text: Coral grew in large colonies on Mon Cala, with their hard skeletons forming coral reefs that acted as shelter and feeding and breeding grounds for various species of fish, crustaceans, and other sea life.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: Coral grew in large colonies on Mon Cala, with their hard skeletons forming coral reefs that acted as shelter and feeding and breeding grounds for various species of fish, crustaceans, and other sea life.

facts.text: The coral tended to thrive in areas bathed in the light of Mon Cala's twin suns, but some hardier species dwelt out of the light deep below the surface.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: The coral tended to thrive in areas bathed in the light of Mon Cala's twin suns, but some hardier species dwelt out of the light deep below the surface.

facts.text: In these deep sea beds of limited light, bioluminescence was a common trait for plants.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: In these deep sea beds of limited light, bioluminescence was a common trait for plants.

facts.text: Although sparce, small islands dotted the surface of Mon Cala, with many of these islands forming archipelagos.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: Although sparce, small islands dotted the surface of Mon Cala, with many of these islands forming archipelagos.

facts.text: The terrain of these islands ranged from rocky cliffs, to sandy beaches with dense jungle.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: The terrain of these islands ranged from rocky cliffs, to sandy beaches with dense jungle.

facts.text: The polar regions were colder then the rest of the planet with ice floes located in the north.

evidence.section: Description
evidence.quote: The polar regions were colder then the rest of the planet with ice floes located in the north.
